subject: sociology
source_note: Structure follows the IB Diploma Social and Cultural Anthropology guide: Part 1 (the language of anthropology), Part 2 (engaging with anthropological practice), Part 3 (organizing knowledge), the HL extension 'the global and the local', and the internal assessment. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
